title: Add a new property
description: Create new → Property, through the five-part New property wizard. Built with the live builder.

steps.title: Start with Create new
steps.text: Everything you add in DoorLoop starts here: properties, leases, tenants, and more. Click Create new.

steps.title: Open Rentals
steps.text: Properties and units live under Rentals. Click Rentals.

steps.title: Choose Property
steps.text: Click Property to open the New property wizard.

steps.title: Residential or commercial?
steps.text: Pick Residential for homes and apartments, or Commercial for offices and retail. Click Residential to continue.

steps.title: Choose the property type
steps.text: Read the descriptions and pick the one that fits. If you plan to list it online, choose a residential type.

steps.title: On to the address
steps.text: Click Next to enter the property's address.

steps.title: Enter the address
steps.text: Start typing the street and pick a suggested address. The time zone is set from it.

steps.title: Affordable housing
steps.text: Tick this if the property is federal affordable housing. Leave it unticked otherwise.

steps.title: On to your units
steps.text: Click Next to add the units.

steps.title: Add your units
steps.text: Only the unit name is required. Beds, baths, size and listing price are optional, and you can fill them in later.

steps.title: More than one unit?
steps.text: Click Add another unit for each one. The duplicate icon copies a unit with similar details.

steps.title: On to bank accounts
steps.text: Click Next once your units are in.

steps.title: Choose the bank account
steps.text: Every property needs a bank account. Use your default account, or add a new one just for this property.

steps.title: Last step: ownership
steps.text: Click Next to set who owns the property.

steps.title: Who owns it?
steps.text: Assign one or more owners (their shares must add up to 100%), or choose Self-owned if the property is yours.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Click Finish to create the property. DoorLoop then suggests next steps, like adding listing details or a lease.
